reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing devecocli-backed HarmonyOS device and emulator control, UI automation, build and deployment, logging, linting, signing, and offline documentation search; its primary user-facing purpose is development testing and debugging.

summaries.zh: 通过 devecocli 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供鸿蒙设备与模拟器管理、UI 自动化、构建部署、日志诊断、Lint、签名和离线文档检索工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with devecocli-backed HarmonyOS device and emulator management, UI automation, build and deployment, log diagnostics, linting, signing, and offline documentation search.

capabilities: Lists and controls HarmonyOS devices and emulators
Captures screenshots and dumps or interacts with UI nodes
Reads device application logs and runs lint checks
